messages.content: I don't think this is a genuine Herman Miller. The label looks wrong.
It's absolutely genuine. I bought it from a corporate office liquidation - they had dozens of these chairs.
The label looks printed on, not embossed like my other Aeron. The mesh also feels different.
Herman Miller has changed their labeling over the years. Different manufacturing dates have different labels. This chair is from 2019 - labels were different then.
